zh.description: 运行在腾讯云上的多用户 AI 助手：接入 Slack，一人一个 Hub，记忆和工具按 Hub 隔离；基于 pi-durable 的可恢复执行、分层记忆与 MCP 工具。

en.description: A multi-user AI agent on Tencent Cloud: Slack interface, one Hub per member with per-Hub memory and tools, durable execution on pi-durable, layered memory and MCP tools.

zh.description: 可恢复的多智能体执行底座：主会话澄清需求、保存版本化计划、把任务派给子 agent 并逐个评审，每一步都持久化在 SQLite，进程中断后从最后提交的状态继续。

en.description: A durable base for multi-agent work: a Main conversation clarifies, saves a versioned plan, dispatches tasks to sub-agents and reviews each result, with every step persisted in SQLite so a crash resumes from the last commit.

zh.description: 你正在看的这个站点：博客、笔记和项目放在一起，中英文双语导航。

en.description: The site you are reading: blog, notes, and projects in one place, with bilingual navigation.

zh.description: 围绕 Pi 的交互模式实验，探索更自然的开发工作流与界面反馈。

en.description: An interaction experiment around Pi, exploring a more natural development workflow.
